title: Link join request
description: The body of the session's POST to <run.url>/<run_id>/sessions on its gateway's link, application/json, which joins a session to the open run: the names of the variables the session passes a value for, whether the gateway sets a model key for the session's requests and, optionally, the model key the session starts with. Behind a separate gateway the request contains the run's run key, whose run the run_id of the path must be, any other run_key_invalid. A body this schema refuses, a member it does not define among them, is invalid_request; a placeholder of a credential or a tool the gateway holds among passes is placeholder_conflict, a 403, and the run stays open; a join of a run that has ended is a 410.

version.description: The document format. The gateway reads version 1 alone.

passes.description: The names of the variables the session passes a value for: what it inherits, what the harness sets and its variables. Names alone, never a value. The gateway answers the join with placeholder_conflict, a 403, when a placeholder of a credential or a tool it holds for the run is among them. An empty list passes none.

model_key.description: Whether the gateway sets a model key for this session's requests. When it is false, the gateway's proxy sets no model key, the active key neither, from the join's 200 until the gateway receives the session's dev.qory.session.exited, the join answer has no model_provider_credential_name, and the request may not contain model_provider_credential_name. The session sends false for a session with no runtime.

model_provider_credential_name.description: The name of the model key the session starts with, one of the model keys the gateway holds for the run, from the server or the machine. Absent, it means the default model provider credential, the run answer's model_provider_credential_name, or, when the default model provider credential is in a key group, that group's active key. The name of a key of a key group means that group's active key: the key the proxy switched to after a limit refusal. The name of a key of the default model provider credential's group that is not active means the active key too. For a group other than the default model provider credential's that no session used yet, it means the named key, or, when the named key is in cooldown or out, the key a limit refusal switches to. When no key of that group is usable, it means the named key: the session's first request with the group's placeholder gets the gateway's 429 with no Retry-After, and the answer to its next batch has stop (README §Credentials, Several model keys). The name of a model key of the machine's means that key alone. A name of no model key of the run is invalid_request, and so is model_provider_credential_name beside a model_key of false.
